title: How is Adolf Hitler connected to Jensen Huang?
hook: How is Adolf Hitler connected to Jensen Huang?
description: Six real photos connect Adolf Hitler to Jensen Huang: Molotov in Berlin, Truman at Potsdam, Nixon, Reagan, and Donald Trump at the White House.
fun_fact: Before he founded Nvidia, Jensen Huang worked at Denny's as a teenager, washing dishes and busing tables.
research_note: Germany's chancellors are too short a list for a scroll, so Hitler leaves through his 1940 Berlin talks with Molotov; the best-known copy of that meeting carries a Getty watermark, so this uses a public-domain photo from the same day.

image.file: File:Встреча Молотова и Гитлера в Берлине. Кадр 1 (полная версия).jpg

links.line: In 1940, Hitler welcomed the Soviet foreign minister, Molotov, to the Reich Chancellery in Berlin.

image.file: File:Potsdam Stalin Truman Gromyko Byrnes Molotov 1945 Jul 18.png

links.line: In 1945, Molotov posed beside President Harry Truman at the Potsdam Conference.

image.file: File:Nixon meeting with former President Harry S.Truman - NARA - 194615.tif

links.line: In 1969, President Richard Nixon visited the former president, Harry Truman, in Missouri.

image.file: File:Ronald Reagan, Nancy Reagan, Pat Nixon, and Richard Nixon in 1970.jpg

links.line: In 1970, Nixon hosted California's governor, Ronald Reagan, and Nancy Reagan at his home.

image.file: File:President Ronald Reagan Shaking Hands with Donald Trump at a Reception for Members of The "Friends of Art and Preservation in Embassies" Foundation in The Blue Room - DPLA - 3c82cdc73bac5205a60dcc8834e9c8de.jpg

links.line: In 1987, President Reagan shook hands with a young Donald Trump at a White House reception.
In 2025, Jensen Huang joined Trump at the White House.
